extDescription.message: Makes Google Drive feel like Windows 11 File Explorer: medium icons, Fluent icons, a Win11 context menu, Properties, a toolbar with an address bar, a Recycle Bin, and dark mode for Docs/Sheets/Slides.

optMediumIconsHint.message: Restyles Drive's grid view: compact tiles, names below icons.

optContextMenuHint.message: Shift + right-click shows Drive's own menu.

optDebug.message: Debug: log selector matches to the console

btnDiag.message: Copy diagnostics from current Drive tab

diagNoTab.message: Open a drive.google.com tab first (and reload it after installing).

footer.message: Changes apply immediately. No network requests, no account access.

optSuppressDetailsHint.message: Keeps the right-hand Details pane from appearing. Use Properties (Alt+Enter) instead.

optExplorerToolbarHint.message: ← → ↑ and refresh buttons, a /path address bar and a view switch. Alt+↑ or Backspace goes up.

optFluentIconsHint.message: Yellow folders and Fluent-style type icons in medium icons view. Thumbnails are kept.

optHideSuggestionsHint.message: Hides Suggested folders/files, quick access and Gemini chips on Home and My Drive.

optRecycleBinHint.message: Double-click it to open Trash, or drop items on it to delete them (Ctrl+Z undoes).

optCtrlCCopiesLinkHint.message: Replaces Drive's own Ctrl+C (copy/paste of items) with copy link.

optRootRedirectApp.message: App window starts in My Drive

optRootRedirectAppHint.message: In an installed Drive app window, the Home page redirects once to My Drive.

optRootRedirectTabs.message: Normal tabs start in My Drive too

optRootRedirectTabsHint.message: Same redirect for regular browser tabs.

structureCopied.message: Page structure copied ($1). File names and IDs are removed.
